patches.summary: (Not a real patch — verifier workaround.) Framework-generated REST client + MCP method-dispatch code uses 'PATCH' as a literal HTTP verb. The verifier's bare-substring scan flags this as if it were a hand-authored customization.
patches.reason: verify_publish_package.py:has_patch_marker() does substring scan for 'PATCH' in .go files, which false-positives on legitimate HTTP-verb usage. Both files are byte-identical to printing-press generate output. To be removed once cli-printing-press#845 lands a comment-anchored marker check.
patches.validated_outcome: Files are framework-emitted; this entry exists only to satisfy the post-#350 verifier without lying about the customization status.
